visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a light gray hoodie sits on a floor in front of a neutral-toned curtain. He gestures towards a large yellow cardboard box with a cartoon lion logo that says 'Simba'. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) He holds up a packaged light blue baby bib with star patterns, turning it over to show the cardboard backing. The background is slightly blurred, showing a domestic indoor setting with soft lighting. (3) The man reaches into the box and pulls out various baby bottles in different colors (beige, blue, pink). He holds a light blue bottle close to the camera, showcasing its matte texture and curved shape. (4) He holds up two packages of baby food scissors, one blue and one beige. He brings them close to his face, pointing at the packaging details. (5) A series of quick cuts shows various thermos flasks in purple, rose, and gray colors. He holds a purple one with two handles, showing how it can be held. (6) He unboxes a beige thermos with a straw, removing a plastic wrap. He then shows a blue bowl shaped like a macaron and a set of baby spoons and forks in a white plastic package. (7) Finally, he holds up a bottle of cleaning liquid in a clear plastic bag and a long-handled brush, gesturing with them towards the camera while smiling.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar melody and high-energy male speech. A soft 'thud' of a box moving is heard. (2) A 'Whoosh' sound effect triggers as he presents the bib, followed by a 'Pop' sound. The speaker's pitch is elevated. (3) Continuous plastic rustling is audible as he pulls out items. A 'Ding' bell sound plays to emphasize a new product. (4) A second voice (female) provides brief, high-pitched exclamations of agreement like 'Oh~' and 'Pretty'. (5) Fast-paced editing transitions are marked by subtle rhythmic 'swishes'. The BGM maintains a steady 115 BPM tempo throughout. (6) More plastic rustling and a clicking sound occur as a lid is opened. The speaker's volume increases with excitement while describing the colors. (7) The video ends with a final upbeat musical flourish and a friendly closing sentence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Itemized Showcase -> Brand Affirmation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional unboxing and detailed showcase of 'Simba' (小獅王辛巴) baby products. The creator uses a high-energy, personal tone to highlight the aesthetic design (matte textures, 'literary' colors) and practical features (waterproofing, 3D pockets) of the items, aiming to endorse the brand to parents.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator unboxes a large branded box, repeatedly names the brand 'Simba', showcases almost every new product in a positive light, and uses professional product shots.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features high production value with dense text overlays and rhythmic sound effects typical of social media product promotions.
